name: api-go
title: API with Go and chi
description: An HTTP API in Go with the chi router: standard middlewares, JSON and tests with httptest. No heavy frameworks.
author: Marlon Chaviano

verify.command: go mod tidy && go vet ./... && go build ./... && go test ./...

instructions:
## How to work here

- Routes in `router.go` (`newRouter`), grouped by resource with `r.Route("/resource", ...)`. Small handlers that return JSON with `writeJSON`.
- Use only the standard library and chi; before adding a module, check whether `net/http` or chi already covers it.
- Return errors with context (`fmt.Errorf("...: %w", err)`), never ignore them.
- Before finishing a task: `go vet ./...` and `go test ./...`.
